_analysis_notes.summary: The project lacks a central README.md, and the frontend documentation is purely boilerplate. This plan covers the creation of a root README and the refinement of package-specific documentation to reflect the actual Job Fit Classifier application.
_analysis_notes.impact_description: Coordinates documentation across the entire project structure to ensure a unified developer experience.

steps.title: Create root README.md
steps.description: Create a README.md file in the project root directory. Include project name (Job Fit Classifier), high-level architecture (Angular 21 + FastAPI + Logistic Regression), directory structure overview, and quick-start links to each package.
steps.validation: Verify root README.md exists and accurately describes the full stack.

steps.title: Update Frontend documentation
steps.description: Comprehensive edit of Front_end/README.md. Replace Angular CLI boilerplate with details about the recruiter-facing batch screening UI, PrimeNG components used, and service integration with the backend API.
steps.validation: Verify Front_end/README.md describes the recruiter dashboard and batch upload features.

steps.title: Refine Backend documentation
steps.description: Update Back_end/README.md to include a 'Project Overview' section linking to the root README.md and ensure all listed endpoints (/screen, /job-fit, /predict_json) match the current codebase.
steps.validation: Verify Back_end/README.md is consistent with the root documentation and current API state.
